podcast.title: Aretha Franklin's 80s Comeback Sound
podcast.body: Luther Vandross introduced "a new brand of synthesized funk" into Aretha Franklin's music with her 1982 album *Jump to It*, playing a crucial role in her 1980s comeback and modernizing her sound. "kicked up the tempo, and brought in a new brand of synthesized funk."
